long_biography.plain_text:
Long-short equity investing shaped Stephen Clive Roberts's career. He became a partner at Horseman Capital and managed its European Select fund, launched in the mid-2000s. Roberts closed the strategy in 2019 and stepped away from professional fund management. During that interval, he and his daughter, Annie Roberts, wrote a guide to stock-market investing.

The break ended in 2024, when Roberts established Jersey-based Orgueil Capital. He directs the firm's concentrated global portfolio through a blend of top-down themes, company-level fundamental work and a macroeconomic overlay. He committed substantial personal capital alongside outside investors, adding his own financial risk to the fund's mandate. The new mandate widened his earlier European focus into global equities while preserving an active long-short method.
